run_rotamer_trials: run rotamer recovery trials on a test dataset using a trained protein EBM model
run_pair_atom_analysis: run atom pair distance energy analysis by varying distances between two atoms in a protein
run_chi_angle_energy_scan: run a chi angle energy scan across 360 degrees for each residue in a protein structure
run_tsne_representations: run t-SNE representation extraction for residues in a PDB structure using a trained model
run_rotamer_packing: run rotamer packing analysis on a protein structure using a trained energy-based model
